query: Why do resolution duration values vary across tickets?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: A clean categorisation derived from short_description, giving a strong grouping axis for explaining duration variation. Values match source text well (WiFi->network_connectivity, VPN->vpn_access, database->database).

per_column.name: failure_mode
per_column.rationale: Adds a distinct axis (nature of failure) beyond category, useful for modelling duration. Mostly warranted (connect->connectivity_failure), though 'access online database'->access_denied is a plausible but slightly inferential reading.

per_column.name: affected_system_scope
per_column.rationale: Server/network/client scope is a genuinely useful grouping for duration analysis. Values are reasonable inferences but sometimes soft (database->server_side, printing->client_side are plausible readings of terse text).

per_column.name: assigned_resolver
per_column.rationale: Values are a direct copy of the existing closed_by/assigned_to fields; well grounded but largely redundant with original columns, adding little new analytical leverage.

per_column.name: resolver_match
per_column.rationale: A boolean of whether assignee equals closer could relate to duration, so it has some leverage. Derivable from original assigned_to vs closed_by, but samples only show closed_by, so the match basis is only partially verifiable.

per_column.name: ticket_open_hour_band
per_column.rationale: Time-of-day band is a plausible driver of resolution duration (staffing shifts) and is cleanly derived from opened_at timestamps. Samples all correct.

per_column.name: caller_id_group
per_column.rationale: Purports to group callers but the sampled values do not correspond to the source caller and appear unrelated/invented (source rows don't even show caller_id yet specific names are assigned). Redundant with caller_id and poorly grounded.

judge.rationale: The semantic categorisation columns (incident_category, failure_mode, affected_system_scope) and ticket_open_hour_band provide genuine, well-grounded axes for explaining why resolution durations vary. assigned_resolver largely duplicates existing fields, resolver_match is partially verifiable, and caller_id_group appears both redundant and ungrounded (values not supported by the source). Overall the set offers real analytical leverage but with one clearly hallucinated column dragging groundedness down.
